scope: Record cases where Awoken acquisition eligibility and actual usability remain aligned, so race restriction is not accidentally inferred from acquisition-only evidence.

records.name: Super Saiyan
records.reason: Current Awoken references classify Super Saiyan as Saiyan-only; Future Warrior documentation describes the transformation as available through Vegeta's Capsule Corporation training for a Saiyan Future Warrior.

records.name: Super Vegeta
records.reason: The Awoken Skill is part of the Saiyan Super Vegeta branch and the Future Warrior documentation describes it as a Saiyan transformation.

records.name: Future Super Saiyan
records.reason: Awoken references classify Future Super Saiyan as Saiyan-only; the documented unlock path is the post-game secret story sequence and the transformation is a Saiyan form.

note: This batch intentionally records alignment rather than changing canonical restrictions. It prevents the acquisition-vs-use distinction from being applied where the evidence does not show a divergence.
